population_1990.source: US Census Bureau, 1990 decennial census, New York City total population
population_1990.note: 1990 murders and robberies are not here: 11_context_city.py sums them from the CompStat precinct tables and asserts they equal NYPD's citywide totals (2,262 and 100,280)

murders_2025.source: Governor Hochul / Mayor Mamdani / Commissioner Tisch release, 2026-01-06, NYPD data as of 2025-12-31

shootings_2025.source: same release; previous record low 754 in 2018

robbery_rate_2025_per_100k.source: Major Cities Chiefs Association Violent Crime Survey, year-end 2025; New York City from the NYPD/Governor year-end release of 2026-01-06 (15,065); population US Census Bureau Vintage 2025 population estimates (July 1, 2025), via Wikipedia's List of United States cities by population

robbery_rank_2025.source: cities over 550,000 people with a year-end 2025 count in the MCCA survey; Jacksonville, Charlotte and Washington could not be joined
robbery_rank_2025.note: lower rate than Chicago, Houston, Philadelphia, Los Angeles, San Francisco and Seattle; higher than Phoenix, Dallas, San Antonio, San Diego, Austin and Fort Worth

lowest_murder_year.source: NYPD historical tables; 2017 was the lowest year since 1951, so 2025 (305) is near but not at the all-time low
